residuals(type = \deviance\") needs each row's own log-density, and the 'toy' family supplies its likelihood one response at a time. A family that has the per-row factors declares them with frmtmb_structure(loglik_row = ). Use type = \"pearson\""

The 'toy' family reports a saturated log-density BELOW the fitted one at 1 row(s) (first at row 2: -2 against -0.5). The saturated value is the largest the row's density can reach, so no fit can beat it and a unit deviance cannot be negative
